name: Park Jae-hyun
bio:
Park Jae-hyun's journey to the pinnacle of motorsport is one of meticulous planning and calculated risk. Born in Busan, his fascination with speed began with go-karting, quickly evolving into a deep understanding of automotive engineering. He earned a degree in mechanical engineering from Seoul National University before relocating to Europe to immerse himself in racing technology. He spent years climbing the ranks, from junior engineer to head of aerodynamics, before proving his leadership capabilities. 

Park's management style is centered around fostering a culture of continuous improvement. He believes in empowering his team through clear communication and data-driven decision-making. He is known for his calm demeanor under pressure, a stark contrast to the high-octane environment of Formula 1, which allows him to evaluate situations objectively and guide the team effectively.

What sets Park apart is his unwavering focus on long-term strategy. While some team principals are swayed by short-term gains, Park maintains a visionary outlook, prioritizing sustainable growth and innovation to ensure Aston Martin remains competitive for years to come. He is not afraid to challenge conventional wisdom and embraces new technologies to gain a competitive edge.
